messages:
tom_finance: Flags from CS — three customers reported being billed twice for Mar usage. Quick look at the usage reconciliation dashboard shows duplicate usage rows for several subscriptions: https://redwood.internal/billing/usage/recon/1763
maya_eng: I checked the ingestion logs for usage-webhook-listener. We received stripe.event invoice.created (usage_report) twice with same stripe_event_id se_8a9Zx. Our handler publishes to kafka topic `usage-events` and the consumer `usage-importer` processed the dupes because we only had at-least-once semantics, no event dedupe.
liam_accounting: Can you dump the net_suite_lines that were created? We need to identify which invoices have double quantity lines before generating credits.
maya_eng: SQL to find dupes: 
```
SELECT subscription_id, usage_date, item_code, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(quantity) as total_qty
FROM net_suite_invoice_lines
WHERE source = 'usage-importer' AND source_event_id = 'se_8a9Zx'
GROUP BY subscription_id, usage_date, item_code
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
ops-bot: job: usage-importer v1.12 failed healthcheck, restarted by ci-bot at 2026-01-14T04:15Z :wrench:
alex_support: Opening ticket SYS-4221 to track impacted customers and credit requests. I've added the 3 customer IDs and prod logs link. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SYS-4221
tom_finance: Pause the daily usage->NetSuite push for now. We should not auto-post credits until we know the scope. Can support apply temporary manual credits to the 3 customers?
liam_accounting: We can do manual credits, but prefer to auto-generate once we dedupe source lines. Manual run needed for 3 accounts; what about the rest?
maya_eng: Mitigation plan: 1) Pause NetSuite push (I can flip the feature flag) 2) Add a processed_event table (processed_stripe_event_ids) with unique constraint on event_id 3) Backfill by scanning net_suite_invoice_lines for null source_event_id and populate with seen IDs 4) Reconcile and run a dedupe job to collapse duplicate lines into single line per usage record. I will open PR for the schema + idempotency in a few mins.
billing-bot: alert: usage discrepancy metric spike +220% at 2026-01-14T04:12Z. Investigating.

maya_eng: logs showing double publish from listener:
```
2026-01-14T04:11:58Z INFO listener: received stripe event se_8a9Zx usage_report
2026-01-14T04:11:58Z INFO listener: publishing to kafka topic usage-events partition 3 offset 8421
2026-01-14T04:11:58Z ERROR listener: unexpected upstream retry, re-delivering event se_8a9Zx
2026-01-14T04:11:58Z INFO listener: publishing to kafka topic usage-events partition 3 offset 8422
```
tom_finance: ETA for hotfix? We need credits out by EOD for the three customers or we'll escalate.
maya_eng: Hotfix (schema + middleware idempotency) -> PR opened, will try to get it to prod in ~90m. I'll also provide a backfill script to mark processed_event_ids and a dedupe utility to create netSuite adjustments safely.
liam_accounting: Please include a dry-run option for the dedupe job so we can review candidates first. Also send me the list of invoices you'll touch.
alex_support: I will notify the three customers we are investigating and will proactively credit if confirmed. Created support notes in each ticket.
ops-bot: feature-flag: paused `ns_push_usage_lines` by ops at 2026-01-14T04:20Z :no_entry_sign:
tom_finance: Thanks. Keep this thread updated. After hotfix and backfill, we'll schedule a short postmortem and update the billing incidents log.
